Package com.signalwire.sdk.swml

Class Document

java.lang.Object
com.signalwire.sdk.swml.Document
public class Document extends Object
SWML Document model.

A document has a version, sections (each a list of verbs), and a top-level verbs list that maps to the "main" section.
